title: Mitmweb frontend bootstrap, state orchestration, and backend RPC callpath
answers: How does the mitmweb frontend initialize and connect to the backend?
How do user actions in mitmweb trigger backend flow mutations?
How is URL routing handled without react-router in mitmweb?
body:
1. `web/src/js/app.tsx` initializes Redux with `web/src/js/ducks/store.ts:store` and checks `window.MITMWEB_STATIC`.
2. If static, it mounts `web/src/js/backends/static.tsx:StaticBackend`; otherwise, `web/src/js/backends/websocket.tsx:WebSocketBackend`.
3. `WebSocketBackend` fetches initial state via `web/src/js/utils.ts:fetchApi` (`/flows`, `/options`) and listens on WebSocket for real-time events, dispatching to `web/src/js/ducks/flows/index.ts` and `web/src/js/ducks/options.ts`.
4. UI mutations (resume, kill, duplicate) trigger actions in `web/src/js/ducks/flows/_backend_actions.ts`, issuing POST requests to `/flows/{id}/{action}` via `fetchApi`.
5. `web/src/js/urlState.ts:useUrlState` synchronizes filter and selection state directly with the browser URL without using react-router.
says: Live traffic list stops updating in real time when connection to backend drops.
Action buttons to resume or kill intercepted requests do nothing in the web UI.
Opening the exported static report fails to load traffic flows in the browser.
Duplicating an intercepted flow from the web dashboard fails to send the action.
